text: つまずいて　ころんじゃった　ポケモンの　イシツブテだわ！

structure.jp: つまずいて　ころんじゃった
structure.en: that I tripped on and fell over

structure.jp: ポケモンの　イシツブテだわ！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: じゃった is the casual short form of でしまった, which says something happened by accident or to your regret. ころんじゃった = 'I went and fell over'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つまずいて　ころんじゃった　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed before a noun describes that noun. つまずいて　ころんじゃった　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon I tripped on and fell over'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: つまずいて　ころんじゃった
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions, the first leading to the second. つまずいて　ころんじゃった = 'I tripped and fell'.
